response.sql:
WITH filtered_tracks AS (
  SELECT TrackId, MediaTypeId, Bytes, Milliseconds
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes >= 10323804
),
media_type_averages AS (
  SELECT m.Name,
    AVG(CAST(ft.Bytes AS DECIMAL(20,10)) / CAST(ft.Milliseconds AS DECIMAL(20,10))) as avg_bytes_per_ms
  FROM filtered_tracks ft
  JOIN MediaType m ON ft.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY ft.MediaTypeId, m.Name
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) as overall_avg
  FROM media_type_averages
)
SELECT mta.Name, mta.avg_bytes_per_ms, mta.avg_bytes_per_ms - oa.overall_avg as above_average
FROM media_type_averages mta
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
WHERE mta.avg_bytes_per_ms > oa.overall_avg
ORDER BY mta.Name

assumptions.assumption: "The average bytes per millisecond" for each media type is the arithmetic mean of (Bytes ÷ Milliseconds) computed for each individual track, not (SUM(Bytes)) ÷ (SUM(Milliseconds)) across all tracks.

alternatives.interpretation: The average bytes per millisecond for each media type is computed as total bytes divided by total milliseconds (weighted average), rather than averaging the per-track ratios.
alternatives.sql:
WITH filtered_tracks AS (
  SELECT TrackId, MediaTypeId, Bytes, Milliseconds
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes >= 10323804
),
media_type_ratios AS (
  SELECT m.Name,
    CAST(SUM(ft.Bytes) AS DECIMAL(20,10)) / CAST(SUM(ft.Milliseconds) AS DECIMAL(20,10)) as bytes_per_ms
  FROM filtered_tracks ft
  JOIN MediaType m ON ft.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY ft.MediaTypeId, m.Name
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms) as overall_avg
  FROM media_type_ratios
)
SELECT mtr.Name, mtr.bytes_per_ms, mtr.bytes_per_ms - oa.overall_avg as above_average
FROM media_type_ratios mtr
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
WHERE mtr.bytes_per_ms > oa.overall_avg
ORDER BY mtr.Name
